summary_1line: Sati and Shiva wed joyfully, live together as he teaches devotion and self-knowledge, but conflict begins when Daksha insults Shiva at a grand sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the wedding hall, Shiva and Sati sit on a golden plank garlanding each other while gods shower flower petals from the sky.
In a lush garden by twin rivers, Shiva and Sati sit beneath a banyan tree in loving conversation as nymphs play in the waters nearby.
At the great sacrifice, Daksha stands angrily before the assembly of gods and sages while Shiva sits calm and silent beside Brahma.
